claims.value: Bernardo Bellincioni's sonnet on the portrait of Cecilia
claims.statement: Bernardo Bellincioni's Rime (printed 1493) include a sonnet on a portrait of Cecilia painted by Leonardo. Text and edition page not checked in this session.

Identification of the sitter with Cecilia Gallerani rests on the ermine (Greek galê; and Ludovico's ermine order) and on the 1498 letter and Bellincioni sonnet, which mention a portrait of her but do not describe this panel unambiguously.
